Why Prime Exteriors

Exterior cleaning, restoration and protection

Clean it once, then keep it that way. Most cleaners stop at the clean. We clean the outside, restore what has stained, and seal it so it holds its finish. One trade, one point of contact, for homes and commercial property across Melbourne.

  1. 01

    Clean

    Pressure and soft washing matched to the surface, so nothing is damaged and the result lasts.

    • Pressure and surface cleaning
    • Soft washing for render and cladding
    • Windows, gutters, roof and solar
  2. 02

    Restore

    Oil, rust, graffiti and organic staining removed before it is sealed in permanently.

    • Graffiti and paint removal
    • Oil and rust stain removal
    • Efflorescence and hard water stains
  3. 03

    Protect

    Sealing and surface coatings so the surface sheds what it used to soak up, and stays clean for years.

    • Concrete and driveway sealing
    • Paver sealing and re-sanding
    • Anti slip and colour sealing
